# vinyl-wall-vendor

React, react-dom and [appica-ui](https://github.com/appica-dev/appica-ui) (with Base UI and Motion) bundled into one ES
module for the [Vinyl Wall](https://github.com/ober37/vinyl-wall) page, which loads it from jsdelivr. Not meant for
other use. Built from `web/vendor/` in that repo; the versions inside match `web/package.json`.
